title: Goal-Branching LaCAM: Temporary Goals as Search Branches in Dense Multi-Agent Pathfinding
abstract: arXiv:2611.07528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LaCAM is a search-based solver for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) that runs a depth-first search over joint configurations, using PIBT to generate successors and lazily adding single-agent constraints to explore alternatives. Although LaCAM is complete, it can struggle on dense, corridor-heavy instances because extracting blocking agents from deadlocks requires coordinated moves of several agents, often away from their goals, which PIBT's greedy one-step successors rarely propose and which LaCAM can only reach by enumerating constraints one agent at a time. This paper proposes Goal-Branching, where blocking agents are given temporary goals, each tried as an additional branch of LaCAM's search. We examine random and corridor-aware rules for choosing these temporary goals and show that completeness is preserved for any such rule. translated_title: 目标分支LaCAM：以临时目标作为搜索分支求解密集多智能体路径规划
translated_abstract: LaCAM是一种基于搜索的多智能体路径规划（MAPF）求解器，它对联合配置进行深度优先搜索，使用PIBT生成后继节点，并通过惰性添加单智能体约束来探索替代方案。尽管LaCAM具有完备性，但在密集且走廊繁多的实例上会表现不佳，因为将阻塞的智能体从死锁中解救出来需要多个智能体的协调移动，这些移动往往偏离各自的目标，而PIBT的贪婪单步后继节点很少会提出此类移动，LaCAM只能通过逐个枚举智能体约束来达到这些移动。本文提出目标分支方法，即为阻塞智能体分配临时目标，并将每个临时目标作为LaCAM搜索的额外分支进行尝试。我们研究了选择这些临时目标的随机规则和走廊感知规则，并证明任何此类规则都能保持完备性。在三张迷宫和房间地图的密集实例（60-90%的自由单元格被占用）上，目标分支方法解决了89%的实例……
tldr: 提出目标分支方法，为阻塞智能体分配临时目标并将其作为LaCAM搜索的额外分支，在保持算法完备性的同时显著提升了密集多智能体路径规划实例的求解成功率。
en_tdlr: Goal-Branching assigns temporary goals to blocking agents as additional search branches in LaCAM, preserving completeness while substantially improving solving success on dense multi-agent pathfinding instances.
